summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only, no files changed)  Before planning, I traced the actual watchlist read/write path end to end and even spun up the backend locally to test it directly (signup → create watchlist → logout → fresh login with a brand-new cookie jar, simulating a different device):  - **Backend (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`):** Correctly scopes every read/write to the authenticated user via the `arca_session` cookie → `X-User-Id`. My live test confirmed a watchlist **does** survive logout + fresh login on a "new device." Backend looks correct. - **Client
